description: Browse the ÅSUB (Statistics Åland) PxWeb subject tree. Pass a sub-path like "Statistik" or "Statistik/BE" to list folders (type "l") and tables (type "t", id ends in ".px"); omit path to list the top-level databases (Statistik, Utredning).

path.description: Sub-path under the API base (default empty = database list). e.g. "Statistik" or "Statistik/BE".

name: subjects
title: Subjects
